title: Forward quotient augmentation commutes with tensor and pullback
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism with $\ell$ invertible in every residue field. Use the completed coefficient sheaves of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For $W=X,Y$, let $S_W$ be the ordinary signed tensor of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation], with its representative comparison restricted to flat-term K-flat complexes, and let $T_W$ be the completed tensor. Let $\tau_W:S_W\to T_W$ be natural transformations whose full good-representative square is the one with the specified quotient/zero chain augmentation of [lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-chain]. Let $F$ be ordinary ringed pullback, $\widehat F$ completed pullback, and $\rho:F\to\widehat F$ the actual map of [lem-sf-integral-ordinary-pullback-comparison]. Let $v:F S_Y\to S_X(F\times F)$ be the canonical ordinary comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and let $c:\widehat F T_Y\to T_X(\widehat F\times\widehat F)$ be the completed comparison of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. For all integral constructible $M,N$ on $Y$, the following equality holds: $F(\tau_Y(M,N))\,;\,\rho(T_Y(M,N))\,;\,c(M,N)=v(M,N)\,;\,\tau_X(FM,FN)\,;\,T_X(\rho(M),\rho(N))$, where semicolons denote composition in the written order. No inverses of $\tau$ or $\rho$, properness, Noetherianness, finite dimension or higher operation data are assumed.

proof.text: Use the one-scheme tensor reduction normalization and the tensor-free pullback reduction normalization to express every forward augmentation as the actual coherent reduction/limit unit followed by the limit of b or a. Proved adjunct uniqueness fixes these comparisons without arbitrary witness data.

Apply the coherent tensor/reduction/pullback square to the chosen M,N. The private categorical lemma limit_tensor_augmentation applies the reduction/limit Hom bijection to the tensor augmentation and to each pullback augmentation. The two triangle identities replace their adjoints by b and a. Naturality of the source unit and functoriality of the target tensor then give the reference-limit equation.

Use the recorded invertibility of the three effective counits and expand the definition of the reference completed comparison. Postcompose with the integral tensor model followed by the reference tensor of the two pullback models. Cancel these isomorphisms. Naturality of the tensor model, pullback model and forward pullComparison gives exactly the original displayed equation. All of this is proved in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorPullback_augmentation {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (τX : (tensorModel l E X).tensor ⟶ integralCompletedTensor l E X)
    (τY : (tensorModel l E Y).tensor ⟶ integralCompletedTensor l E Y)
    (hX : TensorAugmentationNormalized l E X τX)
    (hY : TensorAugmentationNormalized l E Y τY)
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y) :
    (PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).map
        (τY.app (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
      (pullComparison l E f).app ((integralCompletedTensor l E Y).obj (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
      ((canonicalIntegralPullbackTensor l E f M N).hom).hom =
    (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X)
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f)
        (tensorModel l E Y) (tensorModel l E X)).hom.app (M.obj, N.obj) ≫
      τX.app
        ((PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj M.obj,
          (PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed l E) f).obj N.obj) ≫
      (integralCompletedTensor l E X).map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullComparison l E f).app M.obj)
          ((pullComparison l E f).app N.obj))
